semanticAssessment: The planted change was deleting the restricted-patch line from REDACTED_TEXT_KINDS in src/adapters/fs/redacting-artifact-store.ts, applied in the working tree only. The OLD test passed against it (8 tests, 8 pass, 0 fail) because its regular expression needs a literal 'kind:' and the restricted.ts call is the shorthand { kind, runId }, so the scan never saw restricted-patch and its floor of 7 was met by the other call sites. The strengthened test, run against the same planted change, ran the target test to its assertion and failed on it for the intended reason, naming restricted-patch and src/app/run-stages/restricted.ts; the sibling tests (every call resolved, the helper self-test) pass, so the failure is the missing redaction decision and not a fixture or parse fault. Removing manual-context fails the same way (src/app/manual-inputs.ts). The planted change was reverted afterwards and the strengthened test passes on the real code (10 of 10).
